name: Tsukimori Aimi
source:
A second year high school girl and Astronomy Club's vice-president. She has a quiet personality and when you become friends with her she usually acts as the listener. However, when you ask her for an opinion, she will read the mood and answer seriously which makes her friends rely on her often.

She prepares for lessons well, has great grades and is much trusted by teachers. Aimi loves reading and on the days off she spends time in home or library, reading books.

Aimi comes from a far-away village and currently she lives with her older sister Yumeno, just the two of them. They split household chores between the two of them and Aimi is in charge of cleaning (since isn't too good of a cook).

Influenced by a book she read when she was young, she grew interested in stars and in the future, wants to work in astronomy-related field.
